source: MakeHuman hm08 base.obj (CC0 1.0, makehumancommunity/makehuman LICENSE.md sec. C): left hand re-posed to the v2 leftHand frame, refit by tools/human-v2plus/hands-native/fit_hand.py (weight-end 28 mm), sized by tools/body-v3/hands-c/build_c.py. c1r2: one Loop subdivision (wrist seam verts and seam-seam edges fixed); wrist transition rebuilt per angle from the forearm ring to the hand section at hand-local x=10 mm (smoothstep radius+centre, monotone), Taubin-smoothed to x+12 mm; area-weighted normals recomputed, seam normals shared with the limbs piece. symmetric-r1: missing right c1 scale applied before the original subdivision/wrist rebuild; rounded historic frame reconstructed and affine centre refined from paired distal points.

correspondence.reason: Original left/right wrist zipper fitting introduced small interior asymmetry; shared interior topology permits exact distal mirror while preserving each wrist seam.
